arxiv-2107-11333.title: Robust Adaptive Submodular Maximization
arxiv-2107-11333.creator: Shaojie Tang
arxiv-2107-11333.description: Abstract The goal of a sequential decision making problem is to design an interactive policy that adaptively selects a group of items, each selection is based on the feedback from the past, in order to maximize the expected utility of selected items. It has been shown that the utility functions of many real-world applications are adaptive submodular.

arxiv-2109-00009.title: Statistical strong lensing. II. Cosmology and galaxy structure with time-delay lenses
arxiv-2109-00009.creator: Alessandro Sonnenfeld
arxiv-2109-00009.description: Abstract Context. Time-delay lensing is a powerful tool for measuring the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} . However, in order to obtain an accurate estimate of H 0 H_{0} from a sample of time-delay lenses, very good knowledge of the mass structure of the lens galaxies is needed.

arxiv-2110-08861.title: 3D-RETR: End-to-End Single and Multi-View 3D Reconstruction with Transformers
arxiv-2110-08861.creator: Zai Shi*, Zhao Meng*, Yiran Xing, Yunpu Ma, Roger Wattenhofer
arxiv-2110-08861.description: Abstract 3D-RETR † † email: zaishi@ethz.ch † † email: zhmeng@ethz .ch † † email: yiran.xing@rwth-aachen.de † † email: cognitive.yunpu@gmail.com † † email: wattenhofer@ethz.ch † † affiliation: ETH Zurich † † affiliation: RWTH Aachen † † affiliation: LMU Munich † † *Equal contribution. 3D reconstruction aims to reconstruct 3D objects from 2D views.

arxiv-2204-10428.title: SINR: Deconvolving Circular SAS Images Using Implicit Neural Representations
arxiv-2204-10428.creator: Albert Reed, Thomas Blanford, Daniel C. Brown, Suren Jayasuriya
arxiv-2204-10428.description: Abstract Circular synthetic aperture sonars (CSAS) capture multiple observations of a scene to reconstruct high-resolution images. We can characterize resolution by modeling CSAS imaging as the convolution between a scene’s underlying point scattering distribution and a system-dependent point spread function (PSF). The PSF is a function of the system bandwidth and determines a fixed degree of blurring on reconstructed imagery.

arxiv-2501-01154.title: Quantum Computing for Partition Function Estimation of a Markov Random Field in a Radar Anomaly Detection Problem
arxiv-2501-01154.creator: Timothé Presles, Cyrille Enderli, Gilles Burel, El Houssaın Baghious
arxiv-2501-01154.description: Abstract In probability theory, the partition function is a factor used to reduce any probability function to a density function with total probability of one. Among other statistical models used to represent joint distribution, Markov random fields (MRF) can be used to efficiently represent statistical dependencies between variables.

arxiv-2511-01823.title: The Inequity of Consumption-Based Tax Systems
arxiv-2511-01823.creator: Thiago Dias, José Roberto Iglesias, Sebastian Gonçalves
arxiv-2511-01823.description: Abstract This study examines the lack of redistributive effectiveness of consumption-based tax systems with respect to social fairness. Through numerical simulations, we explore the wealth exchanges among economic agents subject to flat consumption taxes, comparing universal redistribution with optimal targeted approaches.

arxiv-2512-10066.title: Classifying Metamorphic versus Single-Fold Proteins with Statistical Learning and AlphaFold2
arxiv-2512-10066.creator: Yongkai Chen, Samuel W.K. Wong, S. C. Kou
arxiv-2512-10066.description: Abstract The remarkable success of AlphaFold2 in providing accurate atomic-level prediction of protein structures from their amino acid sequence has transformed approaches to the protein folding problem. However, its core paradigm of mapping one sequence to one structure may only be appropriate for single-fold proteins with one stable conformation.

bonatti-astrologers-guide-1676.title: The Astrologer's Guide (Anima Astrologiae)
bonatti-astrologers-guide-1676.creator: Guido Bonatti (trans. William Lilly)
bonatti-astrologers-guide-1676.description: Bonatti's medieval astrological aphorisms in Lilly's English translation — the bridge between medieval Arabic astrology and the English tradition. Essential traditional astrology.

britannica-1911-wiesbaden.title: Wiesbaden (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-wiesbaden.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-wiesbaden.description: Article 'Wiesbaden' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Prussian province of Hesse-Nassau. It is delightfully situated in a basin under the well-wooded south-western spurs of the Taunus range, 5 m. from the right bank of the Rhine (at Biebrich), and 25 m. of Frankfort-on-Main by rail. The town is on the whole sumptuously built, with broad and regular streets. Villas and gardens engirdle it on the north and east sides and extend up the hills behind.

pmc-10572173.title: Role of Tyrosine Nitrosylation in Stress-Induced Major Depressive Disorder: Mechanisms and Implications
pmc-10572173.creator: Gregory C Wilson, Simone Keitsch, Matthias Soddemann, Barbara Wilker, Michael J Edwards, Erich Gulbins, Paola Giussani
pmc-10572173.description: Major depressive disorder (MDD) has a lifetime prevalence of approximately 10% and is one of the most common diseases worldwide. Although many pathogenetic mechanisms of MDD have been proposed, molecular details and a unifying hypothesis of the pathogenesis of MDD remain to be defined.

pmc-11391335.title: Ulcerative Colitis Associated with Cardiometabolic Disease and Complicated with Autoimmune Pancreatitis
pmc-11391335.creator: Mitsuro Chiba, Takeshi Miura, Hisanori Matsuzawa, Tsuyotoshi Tsuji, Haruhiko Tozawa, Akira Zeniya
pmc-11391335.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Diet-related cardiometabolic diseases and inflammatory bowel disease, common previously in Western countries, are global problems. We hypothesized that inflammatory bowel disease is a lifestyle disease primarily mediated by the current Western diet. We report here the simultaneous onset of ulcerative colitis and autoimmune pancreatitis, a rare systemic complication of inflammatory bowel disease, 2 months after acute myocardial infarction in a patient with type 2 diabetes.

pmc-11472287.title: Zinc oxide/tin oxide nanoflower-based asymmetric supercapacitors for enhanced energy storage devices
pmc-11472287.creator: Vandana Molahalli, Gowri Soman, Vinay S. Bhat, Apoorva Shetty, Abdullah Alodhayb, Gurumurthy Hegde
pmc-11472287.description: Research on energy storage devices has focused on improving asymmetric supercapacitors (ASCs) by utilizing two different electrode materials. In this work, we have successfully prepared a unique material, ZnO/SnO2 nanoflower, via the hydrothermal method. Graphene oxide (GO) was synthesized by applying the modified Hummers' technique.

pmc-11475633.title: Internal Quality Controls in the Medical Laboratory: A Narrative Review of the Basic Principles of an Appropriate Quality Control Plan
pmc-11475633.creator: Lorenz Gruber, Artur Hausch, Thomas Mueller, Giuseppe Lippi
pmc-11475633.description: To ensure the quality of their analyses, medical laboratories carry out internal quality control (IQC) on a daily basis. IQC involves control samples with known target values for all parameters used by a laboratory in clinical practice. The use of IQC enables the laboratory to monitor the accuracy and precision of laboratory results.

pmc-11496241.title: Cognitive behavioral interventions for depression and anxiety in adults with neurological disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11496241.creator: Milena Gandy, Thomas Woldhuis, Wendy Wu, Marette Youssef, Madelyne A. Bisby, Blake F. Dear, Andreea I. Heriseanu, Amelia J. Scott
pmc-11496241.description: We examined the efficacy of cognitive and behavioral interventions for improving symptoms of depression and anxiety in adults with neurological disorders. A pre-registered systematic search of Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, MEDLINE, PsycINFO, Embase, and Neurobite was performed from inception to May 2024.

pmc-11505350.title: Enhancement of Fluoride’s Antibacterial and Antibiofilm Effects against Oral Staphylococcus aureus by the Urea Derivative BPU
pmc-11505350.creator: Jia Liu, Qingqing Weng, Dongxin Da, Shuran Yao, Ying Zhang, Yang Wu, Carlos M Franco, Célia Fortuna Rodrigues
pmc-11505350.description: Background: The oral cavity is an important but often overlooked reservoir for Staphylococcus aureus. The effective control and prevention of S. aureus colonization and infection in the oral and maxillofacial regions are crucial for public health. Fluoride is widely used in dental care for its remineralization and antibacterial properties. However, its effectiveness against S. aureus has not been thoroughly investigated.

pmc-12378197.title: Epsin1 enforces a condensation-dependent checkpoint for ubiquitylated cargo during clathrin-mediated endocytosis
pmc-12378197.creator: Susovan Sarkar, Hao-Yang Liu, Feng Yuan, Brandon T Malady, Liping Wang, Eileen M Lafer, Jessica Perez, Jon M Huibregtse, Jeanne C Stachowiak
pmc-12378197.description: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis internalizes proteins and lipids from the cell surface. A flexible condensate of initiator proteins catalyzes assembly of clathrin-coated vesicles in diverse organisms. Here we reveal that an endocytic adaptor protein, Epsin1, conditionally stabilizes this network, creating a cargo-dependent endocytic checkpoint. Epsin1 recruits ubiquitylated cargo to endocytic sites.

pmc-13575218.title: Causal machine learning for extracting insights from observational radiotherapy data
pmc-13575218.creator: Margaret Y. Sui, Kyra L. Rosen, Ariel Yuhan Ong, Joseph C. Kvedar
pmc-13575218.description: While clinical trials are the gold standard for determining causative side effects from treatment, some trials are too logistically or ethically challenging to complete. Many side effects of treatments are learned from retrospective analyses; however, these can be confounded by other random variables.
